newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast products flat as players watch NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast products flat as players watch NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot product prices were flat to lower Wednesday, as traders watched influencial crude oil futures extend yesterday's fall.
Falling crude futures could signal the return of better refinery profits, which have shrunk the last month because of pricey crude oil values, traders said.
With the market in flux, few refiners played in the market Wednesday.
"I haven't heard of any buyers today," one trader said.
Los Angeles regular CARB-grade cleaner burning gasoline was talked near 62 cents a gallon, about 0.50 cents lower than Tuesday.
Prompt regular unleaded gasoline in Los Angeles was offered at 59 cents, a notional two two cents lower than earlier this week, traders said.
CARB diesel fuel was flat from Tuesday at 63/64 cents.
